hooks.name: Validate tenant on save
hooks.description: When a tenant.yaml, tenant.yml or tenant.json is saved, ask the agent to validate it and keep core untouched.

action.prompt: A tenant config file was just saved. If the root package.json defines the script `validate-tenant`, run `npm run validate-tenant -- <tenant directory>` for that tenant and fix any reported errors in the tenant files. Check the file against .kiro/steering/tenant-plugin-conventions.md (id equals directory name, snake_case tool names, JSON Schema with additionalProperties false, extensionless handler paths). Do not modify anything under packages/core. If the script does not exist yet, only perform the convention check.
